name: myapigeeworkspace
description: Apigee hello-world proxy with CI/CD quality gates

scripts.lint:report: apigeelint -s src/main/apigee/apiproxies/helloworld/apiproxy --profile apigeex -x apigeelint-rules -e TD002,TD007,PO007 -f json.js > reports/apigeelint-baseline.json
scripts.test:unit:coverage: c8 --all --src src/main/apigee --src apigeelint-rules --include "src/main/apigee/**/*.js" --include "apigeelint-rules/**/*.js" --check-coverage --lines 90 --branches 90 --functions 90 --reporter text --reporter html --reporter cobertura --reports-dir reports/coverage mocha --reporter dot "tests/unit/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:api:local
